description: Update an existing Alert State Timeline in OneUptime. Only include the fields you want to change - unspecified fields will remain unchanged. Use get_alert_state_timeline afterwards to see the updated record.

alertStateId.description: Alert State ID Relation. Which alert state does this alert change to?

id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the Alert State Timeline to update. Required. Use list_alert_state_timelines to find IDs.

startsAt.description: When did this status change? Correct this when the recorded time is wrong - every measurement derived from this timeline is recomputed from the corrected value.

name: update_alert_state_timeline
title: Update Alert State Timeline
